prompts.title: Recent form as kinetic type
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 8 seconds, lower quarter permanently reserved for Spanish subtitles (warm white #edf0e6 on GoatLab charcoal #101412). EDITORIAL VARIANT — kinetic typography: full-bleed charcoal stage, one focal point at the vertical centre. Team names 'RACING CLUB DE LENS' and 'SPORTING CLUBE DE PORTUGAL' stack in condensed grotesk caps, warm white, with lime #c5ed74 accent bars. Stages: (0.0–1.5s) entrance — letters slam in from half width with a 3-frame overshoot, slate #8ca6bf hairline rules drawing across; (1.5–5.0s) rhythmic emphasis — each syllable pulses on the beat, lime underline wipes left-to-right under the highlighted word, slate ghost duplicates lag one frame behind for depth; (5.0–7.0s) contrast beat — the two names push apart to opposite thirds of the frame with a thin slate divider; (7.0–8.0s) exit — names compress into a single lime line that slides up and dissolves. Camera: slow push-in of one half height across the whole scene, with a 2-frame shake on each emphasis hit. Transitions: hard cut in, lime wipe transition out. STATISTICAL VARIANT — honest data sequence: identical timing and typography, but instead of numbers the centre holds a restrained geometric block of charcoal and slate rectangles breathing in a slow loop, capped by a large Spanish title 'Datos no disponibles'. Explicitly no chart type, no axes, no baseline, no scale, no units and no zero values — nothing is invented. A small Spanish source line reads 'Fuente: sin datos en el catálogo de esta match' and a sample note reads 'Sample: no publicado'. Emphasis lands only on the title card, never on an implied figure. Camera: gentle drift down by one half height; entry via fade from charcoal, exit via transition wipe to the next scene. On-screen labels are Spanish, hierarchy: title > team names > source line.
